page.layout: One text column, right of centre, with a centred section heading, an italic title and a passage below it. Marginal notes in the left margin (Tolosan note, Sect.XX., Supra). Catchword at lower right. Running head and page number at top.

main_text.p: cipibus exercentes, in Repub. Christiana miras miseriasque tragœdias excitarunt: quibus Nos gloriosissimorum Christi Martyrum quasi agmen opponimus, ab exemplis eorum Pontificum, qui, inter atrocissimas persecutiones, nè tantillum moliti contrà Principes seculares Tolosan. de omnibus Christianis principibus[?], Supra in hoc Cap. §.res , {*}pijfimum hoc dogma tenentes parendi Magistratibus; atque ita suam in Christum fidem, simul & erga Reges fidelitatem sanguine suo obsignârunt. Illi Innocentium IV. Gregorium VII. Clementem VI. Bonifacium VIII. Leonem X. & huiusmodi Regum hostes infensissimos, & improbitatis notis maximè insignes nobis obtrudunt: Nos Liberium I. Leonem I. Anastasium I. Gregorium I. Gelasium I. & priscæ ætatis quoscunque alios, omnium iudicio, sanctissimos Pontifices produximus. Illi, pro Pontificia eminentia, in Pontificibus vilioris Notæ ac nominis Quar-tis, Sextis, Septimis, Octavis, & nonnunquàm Decimis; Nos, ad Regiam authoritatem asserendam in Pontificibus Primis institimus: ita vt, de veritate amplius dubitare, nihil aliud sit, quàm in clarissima luce cœcutire. Hæc de Papa-rum ipsorum iudicijs.
main_text.head: V. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: Imperatorum authoritatem tam ex nominum, in Decretis, præscriptione; quàm ex Eorum, in Concilijs præsi-dentia[?] demonstrari.

main_text.p: QVùm quæcunque hactenùs à Bellarmino prolata fuerè, ad {*}Eminentiam potestatis Pontificiæ super Reges probandam, tanquàm ad scopum proprium collimént omnia; idcirco operæ-pretium duximus (postquàm à Sanctissimorum Pontificum Generalis, quasi, Synodi suffragijs Causam obtinuimus) postremo in loco, veluti ad Cæsaris tribunalia provocantes, vtrum hæc dignitatis authoritatisque Eminentia Principibus tribuenda sit; id est, vtrùm Principibus Reuerentia ac obedientia à Pontificibus debeatur, ex Principum Christianorum rebus gestis [illegible, ~3 letters] experiri.

page.notes: Left margin near "Tolosan" note is partly cut off, so the last words of the note are uncertain ("principibus", "Supra", "§" read with doubt). The asterisk note beside "Quàm" reads "* Supra." and is placed with the mark {*} at "Eminentiam". The black blot after "rebus gestis" hides one word; the number of letters is an estimate. Section heading "præsi-dentia" hyphenation is uncertain. Running head is taken as printed, including "Cap.5.".
